title: Exhibit A
description: A dog prosecutor presents a red laser dot. The cat choir never finishes a vowel. The downbeat is the click they follow instead of the conductor.
stylePrompt: Courtroom doo-wop, 92 BPM, B-flat major. Deadpan tenor lead (dog prosecutor in a rumpled suit — warm, sincere, selling the case to an empty box). Finger snaps on 2 and 4. Upright bass walking. One piano stab on the word "exhibit." No drums except a gavel that is always late. Backup: a cat choir stacked in close harmony who are supposed to hold "ooo." **Structural flaw:** a 5 kHz laser-pointer tick lands every 7 seconds, off the grid, never on a bar line. Each tick, the choir abandons the chord mid-phoneme and the stereo image of them yanks hard right toward the tick; the prosecutor keeps conducting the space they left. By the last chorus there is no choir, only the lead and the tick. Do not bring the cats back for a button. Mood: a trial that is going extremely well for nobody. Runtime ~1:30–1:50. Do not use Continuity Voice (this is not the station). Do not use Dale's gavel as a joke prop — a different bulldog, a different local.
lyrics:
[Intro — snaps, one late gavel]
The people call Exhibit A.
(tick)
Please remain seated.

[Verse 1]
Ladies and gentlemen of the jury
I have a light
I have a wall
I have a theory of the case
The theory is: look
The theory is: look again
You may not pounce
That is in the instructions

[Pre-Chorus]
If you would hold the "ooo"
If you would hold the room
If you would not

[Chorus]
Exhibit A
A red fact on a beige wall
Exhibit A
I rest, I rise, I point
Exhibit A
Please do not follow it
Please follow me
(tick)
(choir gone for one bar)

[Verse 2]
The defendant is also a cat
The defendant is also airborne
I did not call the defendant to the air
I called the defendant to the stand
The stand is still here
The defendant is not

[Pre-Chorus]
Your honor I object to physics
Your honor I object to joy
Your honor I object to the way
A red thing wins a room

[Chorus 2 — choir thinner]
Exhibit A
Still the same dot
Exhibit A
Still the same wall
Exhibit A
I have notes
I have a suit
I have no jury
(tick)

[Bridge — tenor alone, snaps continue]
I was told the evidence would speak
The evidence is a circle
The evidence does not speak
The evidence moves one inch
And the law moves with it
I am still talking
That is also in the instructions

[Final]
Exhibit A
I point
Exhibit A
I rest
Exhibit A
(tick)
(no choir)
Please remain seated.
The seats are empty.
That is my case.
notes:
## What the song is
The prosecutor did not bring a laser to court so the jury would leave. He brought it because it was Exhibit A. The cats did what cats do. He continues, professionally, to an empty box, because the instructions said remain seated and he is the only one who read them.

The joke is the tick, not the cats being cute. Nobody meows on the record. Nobody says "cats, am I right."
